_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: atom_edit_meta keeps the card index in step: a Related or Aka edit now updates the card's index row from the edited content, so related-card spreading and alias lookups follow the card instead of its old links (Trigger and Entry edits behave as before); shipped cards: 35 cards gain follow-up lessons, and the card on verifying parallel implementation lines is replaced by a new card with the same knowledge, whose triggers also keep the word for a full run that the old card's name carried
